column1: Dataset S1: The 14,911 significant SNPs. Locations on chromosomes/scaffolds, where known, are shown, together with the identities of the nucleotide in the reference genome and the overall major and minor nucleotides, as well as the magnitude and direction of the frequency difference in each generation and the generation in which the difference was significant. Positive values indicate higher frequencies of the major nucleotides in the High resistance pool.
